description: This file defines the ObjectUtils class with static methods for manipulating JsonObject instances, including checking for boolean and string entries, creating JSON strings, and adding entries.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for JSON object manipulation, including checking, creating, and serializing boolean and string entries.

methods.name: HasBooleanEntry
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a boolean value for a given key and retrieves it.

methods.name: CreateBooleanJsonString
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representing a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: CreateBooleanObject
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: AddBooleanEntry
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to a JsonObject.

methods.name: HasStringEntry
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a string value for a given key and retrieves it.

methods.name: BoolToJsonString
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its JSON string representation ('true' or 'false').
